subject: Re: Night shift coverage contingency + hotel bunking plan
messages:
From: Samantha Hayes <samantha@eventops.io>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: ops@greenline-sponsor.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Night shift gap for expo — can Redwood help with standby coverage?

Hi Ava —

Quick note from the venue ops team: a wave of red-eye cancellations for our exhibitor flights just came in and we're expecting a shortage for the 11pm–3am expo window on Friday (setup crews and lead presence). GreenLine is asking if Redwood can provide standby staff to cover two booth shifts and a floater for escalations.

Details:
- Venue: Moscone West, Hall B
- Dates: Friday 12/17, midnight coverage (11pm–3am)
- Required roles: 2 booth reps (static), 1 floater (roaming)
- Access: exhibitor badges will be issued on arrival; vendor manager will escort on-site

There is no sponsor budget to cover new air fares; they can arrange local ground stipends and provide hotel rooms for the night. Their ops lead suggested "hotel bunking" on the 3rd/4th floor to reduce cost.

Can you confirm whether you have any local field staff able to take a late-night assignment? If not, would Redwood be open to reassigning a nearby traveler (we can cover ground stipend and reimburse reasonable late-check fees)?

Appreciate a quick thumbs-up/downs so we can lock the venue plan.

Thanks,
Samantha Hayes
Senior Event Operations — EventOps

Attachment: vendor_request_1212.pdf (stub)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Hayes <samantha@eventops.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Night shift gap for expo — can Redwood help with standby coverage?

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the heads up — we can support this with a contingency plan but need to be explicit on staffing constraints and travel costs. Proposed playbook:

1) Local-first: reach out to Bay Area staff who are not committed that evening (we have 3 local folks listed in the shared roster).
2) Reassign: if no locals, offer up to 2 midnight flights to shift volunteers from nearby cities (SFO/OAK) with reimbursed rides + $75 ground stipend. No long-haul tickets.
3) Hotel bunking: agree to GreenLine's bunking approach for a single night-only stay (3–4 people per suite on same floor) — Redwood will sign off if floorplan is provided and it meets basic safety criteria.
4) Roles & pay: Booth reps = standard per-shift rate; floater = lead rate + incident handling stipend.

I attached a working shift matrix (shift_matrix_v3.csv) and the Redwood-approved mini checklist for vendor hotel sharing (hotel_floorplan.pdf).

Ask for internal team: Marcus — can you pull the on-call roster and flag any volunteers for 12/17 midnight? Monica — can you confirm whether our travel budget allows the small SFO/OAK redeployments (estimate attached)? Grace — if we staff this, we should publish a quick KB for the crew with badge pickup and escalation steps; can you draft?

Samantha — if GreenLine can confirm rooming layout by EOD Mon (12/14) we can lock or decline. Otherwise we'll hold a maximum standby of 2 people.

Ava Chen
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: shift_matrix_v3.csv, hotel_floorplan.pdf
